context: Select the smallest durable architecture for Face2AI inside the existing face_recognition fork.

candidates.name: FastAPI + dependency-free browser modules
candidates.summary: One local Python process serves API and static ES modules.
risks: Browser state management may become cumbersome as Party Mirror grows.
non_risks: No Node toolchain is needed for S0.
tradeoff_points: Simplicity now versus frontend component scale later

candidates.name: FastAPI + React/Vite
candidates.summary: Separate typed frontend build with a React component model.
risks: Adds a second toolchain before it creates product value.
non_risks: A later migration is localized to the browser shell.

candidates.name: Desktop shell + React + Python sidecar
risks: Desktop packaging and sidecar lifecycle dominate S0 effort.
non_risks: Can be reconsidered if installed distribution becomes a product goal.

strongest_counterargument: The selected frontend will eventually be less convenient than React if Party Mirror introduces several stateful surfaces and reusable components; the decision is justified only while S0 remains one tightly scoped interaction surface.
decision_rationale: One runtime and no frontend build reduces first-use friction.
Domain ports preserve later engine/store/interaction replacement.
The existing product UI effects can be implemented as adapted CSS/ES modules.
Migration to React remains localized to the browser shell because API contracts are stable.
rejected_alternatives: CAND-002 deferred until frontend complexity triggers fire
CAND-003 rejected for S0 architecture overhead
consequences: S0 frontend has no framework dependency.
Recognition readiness is explicit and separate from process health.
Future Party Mirror attaches through an interaction/event boundary rather than modifying recognition core.

risks.statement: Target-Mac face_recognition dependency chain may not install reproducibly on Python 3.11.
risks.mitigation: Run mandatory compatibility smoke before claiming runtime recognition.

assumptions.statement: The existing repository package remains the recognition source for S0.
assumptions.review_trigger: fork diverges materially or Face2AI is extracted to a separate repository

review_triggers: two or more frontend complexity triggers in ADR-001 fire
product moves beyond local invited-adult S0 use
migration_signals: dedicated distribution becomes a product goal
